questions.q: Where have you been told that faith and science just don't mix?
questions.answer: Mostly in science class. It can feel like faith has to be checked at the door, as if anything about God is just religion and does not belong next to science.

questions.q: What are you learning in school right now that makes you think about God?
questions.answer: One example: in math, seeing how everything follows orderly rules reminds me that God is orderly and made us able to understand his world.

questions.q: Is your faith kept private, or does it show up at school and in public?
questions.answer: Honestly, I often keep Jesus "upstairs" in my private life and leave Him out of school. Faith and life were never meant to be separate, so I want Him in the public rooms too.
